birddog.title: Bird Dog Protocol Simulation
birddog.description: Learn emergency communication protocols for mining haul roads
birddog.scenario1: You're operating a water truck on a narrow haul road. You see a light vehicle approaching at a curve ahead.
birddog.option1B: Radio "Bird Dog" and specify your location
birddog.correct1: Correct! The Bird Dog call alerts all traffic that a light vehicle is in the area.
birddog.incorrect1: The Bird Dog protocol requires radio communication to warn all traffic.
birddog.birdDogExplanation: A radio call used to warn haul truck operators that a light vehicle ("bird dog") is traveling on the haul road. All operators must acknowledge and use extra caution.

radioDiscipline.title: Radio Discipline Simulation
radioDiscipline.description: Practice proper emergency radio communication protocols
radioDiscipline.explanation: "Break, Break, Break" is the universal mining emergency call. It clears the radio channel immediately for critical safety communications.
radioDiscipline.scenario: You witness a haul truck losing control on a ramp. What do you say first?
radioDiscipline.correctPhrase: Excellent! You've mastered the emergency call.
radioDiscipline.incorrectPhrase: Remember: "Break, Break, Break" - say it three times, clearly.

fireSupression.title: Fire in the Pit Simulation
fireSupression.description: Learn proper fire suppression protocols for mining equipment
fireSupression.scenario: You notice smoke coming from a haul truck engine compartment.
fireSupression.correct1: Correct! Always alert others first - fire can spread rapidly and endanger rescue personnel.
fireSupression.incorrect1A: Never open the hood - oxygen feeds the fire!
fireSupression.incorrect1C: Always radio first - others may be in danger and backup may be needed.

crushSyndrome.title: Crush Syndrome Simulation
crushSyndrome.description: Recognize and respond to crush injuries in mining environments
crushSyndrome.warning: Warning: Do not attempt rescue without proper training and equipment
crushSyndrome.scenario: A miner has been trapped under fallen equipment for 45 minutes.
crushSyndrome.keyFact: Crush syndrome can cause fatal heart arrhythmias when pressure is released after 15+ minutes of compression.

loto.title: Lockout/Tagout Simulation
loto.objective: Correctly identify and isolate energy sources before performing maintenance
loto.tryStartButton: Try the START button to verify isolation
loto.success: Excellent! You correctly completed the LOTO procedure.
loto.failureWrongDisconnect: Warning: Wrong disconnect selected. This could energize equipment during maintenance.
loto.failureSkippedVerify: Critical Error: Never skip verification! Equipment could still be energized.
